news_items.headline: TD Cowen maintains Buy on Lamar Advertising, raises PT to $170 from $150
news_items.summary: TD Cowen reiterated a Buy rating on LAMR and raised its 12-month price target to $170 from $150, citing continued execution.

news_items.headline: Lamar Advertising declares $1.60 quarterly dividend, reaffirms 2026 distribution guidance of at least $6.40/share
news_items.summary: Board declared a $1.60 quarterly cash dividend (ex-date Jun 16, 2026) and reaffirmed 2026 distributions of at least $6.40 per share, supporting the REIT income thesis.

news_items.headline: Lamar Advertising CEO Sean Reilly to appear at J.P. Morgan 2026 Global TMT Conference
news_items.summary: CEO Sean Reilly participated in a Q&A session at the J.P. Morgan 2026 Global Technology, Media and Communications Conference on May 18, 2026 at ~3:30 pm EST.

news_items.headline: Lamar Advertising valuation check after reaffirmed dividend and 2026 distribution guidance
news_items.summary: Simply Wall St review of LAMR valuation following the dividend reaffirmation and 2026 payout guidance; piece weighs income story versus current multiple.

analyst_consensus.recent_changes: TD Cowen reiterated Buy and raised PT to $170 (from $150) on 2026-05-14. TipRanks shows month-to-date 13 Buy / 40 Hold / 0 Sell with overall consensus Buy; 3-month avg PT $139.50 (range $128-$145).

earnings_context.notes: Q1 2026 already reported; next call Aug 7, 2026. Management signaled possible upward AFFO guidance revision on August call (current 2025 AFFO/share guide $8.13-$8.28). Programmatic revenue +~25% YoY to ~$11M; digital billboards ~31% of billings.
